headline: The blue seat stops being a mirror
lede: Double Dragon's CPU partner now fights like a partner: he sprints the thug who grabs his brother, his punches break the grip, and his jab-jab-cross rhythm no longer marches in lockstep with Billy's hammer kicks. On a phone, the solo seat finally has a bodyguard.

notes.text: Guardian law: when Billy is in a thug's grip, Jimmy abandons his own nearest mark and charges the holder. Release law (the arcade's relief valve): hit the grabber and he lets go — with mercy i-frames and a blue escape sweep. Works both directions, so a human P2's fists free Billy too.

Technician's cadence: the arcade duo split by school — Billy=power on a 9-beat hammer-kick, Jimmy=technique on a 13-beat jab-jab-cross. 13 is coprime to 9, so the dragons interleave instead of swinging the same bar; the pair reads as two fighters now.

ddragoncheck 112/112 with three new pins, and 11/11 mutants RED-named including guardian-deaf, grip-permanent and cadence-mirror. Solo hashes untouched — attract mode and the WINNABLE proof stream the same old law.

Both builder slots shipped tonight: CONTRA pod carriers (#2850), R-TYPE S4 wing polish (#2853) and this (#2855) — three game-code PRs in a row. Fresh QA polish pass #2857 asks for the guardian telegraph, grip-break juice and KO flair.
